### workspace report-run-status --help
--- exit 0
--- stdout
Usage: workspace report-run-status <uuid> <exit_code>

Internal command called by the --wait shell wrapper.
Reads <uuid>.stdout and <uuid>.stderr from the run results directory,
writes the complete JSON result file, and exits 0.

Examples:
  workspace report-run-status 6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 $?    # the line the --wait wrapper script runs after the command
  workspace report-run-status 6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 0    # record a run that exited 0
  workspace report-run-status 6ba7b810-9dad-11d1-80b4-00c04fd430c8 1    # record a run that failed with status 1; this command still exits 0
--- stderr
--- end
